lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. These are organized into at least seven distinct vertical columns, with the most prominent column containing five vertically aligned spots of high pixel intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with faint horizontal bands to form a lattice-like structure. The high-intensity circular blobs are positioned at the nodes where these vertical and horizontal pixel gradients overlap.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, starting above the gill slits and extending posteriorly. It is defined by a sharp intensity transition, with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal aspect and a shadowed low-luminance gradient on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible first dorsal fin contains approximately seven distinct, irregularly shaped high-luminance blobs. These are non-uniformly distributed, with higher density observed towards the base and trailing edge of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, linear, high-luminance horizontal mark is visible on the lower mid-flank, posterior to the pectoral fin. Small reddish-pink punctate marks are visible in the vicinity of the dorsal-most region of the second and third gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense field of micro-scale high-luminance spots is visible on the anterior cephalic region (snout), exhibiting a significantly higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter compared to the macro-spots on the lateral flank.
